name: IIT Madras
summary: IIT Madras is a public Institute of National Importance in Chennai, on a 617-acre campus carved from the Guindy forest. It is ranked #1 in both the NIRF 2025 Overall and Engineering tables. B.Tech admission is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA; its online BS in Data Science and Applications is open to anyone who has passed Class XII, via a qualifier exam instead of JEE.

totalStudents.notes: "10,000+ students" as stated by IIT Madras.

applicationPlatform.value: B.Tech: JoSAA counselling after JEE (Main) and JEE (Advanced). BS Data Science: IIT Madras online application and qualifier.

testing.notes: For B.Tech and other JoSAA-admitted programmes.

domesticTuition.notes: ₹1,00,000 per semester for General/OBC/EWS with family income above ₹5 lakh; reduced for incomes ₹1–5 lakh and below ₹1 lakh; SC/ST/PwD exempt. Hostel and mess are separate.

scholarships.name: Tuition fee remission (Government of India scheme)
scholarships.eligibility: Indian B.Tech students by family income and category: SC/ST/PwD exempt from tuition; reduced fees for General/OBC/EWS with family income ₹1–5 lakh; tuition waived below ₹1 lakh.
